table.ownRow: You can't change your own access.

invite.title: Invite User
invite.displayNameHint: If you enter a name, the user can't change it. Leave it blank to let them choose their own when they first sign in.

disable.title: Disable {{email}}?
disable.description: This user is signed out immediately and can't sign in until reinvited.

reinviteConfirm.title: Reinvite {{email}}?
reinviteConfirm.description: This user moves from disabled to invited and can sign in again with the same Google account.

delete.title: Delete {{email}}?
delete.description: The account, its sign-in link, sessions and roles are removed permanently. The person can be invited again later as a new account.

edit.displayNameHint: Leave empty to clear it. The user then chooses their own name at their next sign-in.

nameSource.staff: Set by staff; the user can't change it
nameSource.provider: From Google; the user can still change it

edit.adminLocked: Only an Admin can change an Admin's name or console role.
